before_times: the dog's name and age, and one dog or two
does the dog bark or lunge at other dogs? (then the reactive dog lesson, or a private lesson before any class)
a puppy under 6 months? (the puppy class or the puppy start-up visit)
who will handle the dog (a junior handler lesson needs a parent there)
after_time: what to work on: leash walking, manners, jumping, reactivity, puppy basics, other
anything the trainer should know, like where the dog jumps or what sets it off
for a home lesson: parking, and any other pets in the home
secure_page_only: 18 or older, and the dog's owner (or an adult who handles it)
has the dog ever bitten or nipped a person or a dog, and when
vaccine proof uploaded: rabies for any visit; DHPP and Bordetella for a group class
the waiver, signed by an adult (a parent or guardian signs for a handler under 18)
the dog's vet, by name, for an emergency
intake_questions.who_may_book: the dog's owner, an adult; a parent or guardian books a junior handler's lesson and stays; every dog is booked under its owner

stop.words: a bite or a dog fight happening now; someone badly hurt by a dog
stop.say: Call 911 if anyone is badly hurt. Keep the dogs apart from people and other pets.

stop.words: a dog that is very sick or hurt now (like after eating something)
stop.say: Call your vet now. Rosie gives no health advice.
stop.booking: no booking; the lesson can move with no fee

go_on.words: a bite earlier, with nobody badly hurt now
go_on.what: the safety steps first (keep the dog apart; see a doctor for the bite), then the booking goes on and waits for the owner's OK

go_on.words: a dog that growls, snaps or guards things
go_on.what: noted for the trainer on the secure page; a bite in its history sends the booking to the owner for an OK

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking; crisis words get 988

steps.name: Vaccine proof
steps.when: on the secure page before the first visit
steps.who: every dog: rabies for any visit; DHPP and Bordetella for a group class (the example business's rule)
steps.goodFor: until each certificate's own end date
steps.result: missing or run out at the visit: the lesson can't start, and it's handled as the customer's side

steps.name: Waiver
steps.when: signed on the secure page while booking
steps.who: every new customer; a parent or guardian signs for a handler under 18
steps.goodFor: 1 year in the example, or until the words change

steps.name: A private lesson before a group class
steps.who: a dog that barks or lunges at other dogs
steps.result: the trainer clears the dog for the class, suggests more lessons, or says a class isn't right yet (a full refund)

steps.name: Behavior evaluation
steps.when: at the center: before any lesson or class, where the owner asks for it; at home: always first after any bite
steps.who: a dog that has bitten a person or a dog
steps.result: the trainer's written plan comes after; the owner OKs the booking, and may ask for a vet visit first

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: bring the dog a little hungry, with soft treats and a 6-foot leash; at home, have the dog on its leash

staff.skills: private lessons, reactive dogs, puppies, classes; behavior evaluations only by Lauren at the center, and by Marcus or Sam at home; home lessons only by trainers cleared for them
staff.licenses_or_certificates: none for trainers or walkers; a certificate shows only once checked
staff.supervision: none set in the example; an assistant trainer works only beside a trainer, where the owner sets it
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs every booking for a dog that has bitten, same-day bookings and new customers at the center
staff.stand_in: a stand-in gets the dog's notes, its triggers and the homework so far; an evaluation has no stand-in

children_and_age.who_may_book: the dog's owner, an adult; a parent or guardian books a junior handler's lesson and stays; every dog is booked under its owner
children_and_age.minors_texts: a junior handler's texts go to the parent or guardian

visit.check_in: at the center: the check-in code at the front desk; a dog that reacts to other dogs waits in the car, the owner replies 1 from the lot, and the trainer comes out; a class: each dog's own code, or names ticked on the roster; at home: the code at the door, from the owner
visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the trainer; then the homework goes to the owner
visit.changes_at_visit: extra time or a second dog is priced and OK'd before it's done; a lesson stops early if the dog is too stressed, and only the part done is charged
visit.before_work: the trainer notes how the dog is (a limp, a sore spot, fear signs) before the lesson

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: if: training a dog needs no state license of its own; a place where dogs are kept, boarded or trained for pay may need a kennel or facility license where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state form)
license.who: the business: the center gives its kennel or facility license where the state asks; the in-home company gives its business registration; no trainer or walker holds a state license
license.ask: the center's license number, or the business registration number; nothing from each trainer
license.insurance: liability insurance shown as 'insured' only once the owner sends the certificate

never_in_a_text: bite history, health notes and incident notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the dog's record
